title: Spyglass: Unleashing Enhanced Discovery

title: Enhanced File Control in Editor

summary: Explore our exciting new public roadmap to effortlessly track recent releases, preview upcoming features, and get a glimpse of what we're building next.

summary: Experience a more intuitive and efficient workflow with our updated checkboxes, now larger, easier to click, and fully draggable.

summary: Our latest update brings a significantly enhanced collaboration experience to the editor, making real-time teamwork more intuitive and efficient.

title: Smarter Discovery of Shared Items
summary: Easily find and collaborate on important shared content with friends and colleagues, making teamwork more intuitive and productive.

summary: Noeko is now fully open source, empowering our community with complete control and inviting direct collaboration to build the future of the platform together.

summary: Unlock the full potential of your knowledge with powerful new filters, dynamic sorting, and the ability to save your custom searches as personalized collections.

title: Dynamic Content Previews
summary: Experience a more intuitive way to organize your thoughts and structure notes with dynamic previews and enhanced interaction for linked content.

title: A Spectrum of Stunning New Themes

summary: We're enhancing our homepage greetings to always reflect the correct time of day, ensuring a more personalized and accurate welcome for every user.
